TD Studios: Next.js 15.5.4 App Router, strict TypeScript, pnpm, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind v3, shadcn/ui, Vercel/v0.app sync. Dark luxury glassmorphism; mobile-first; analytics, A/B tests, ChatKit support, JWT client portals. Major changes via v0.app; direct edits may affect sync. See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md) and [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json).

Routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. APIs: `api/contact/` (Resend), `api/chatkit/session/` (OpenAI), `api/intake/` (Supabase). `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into service routes.

Code: `app/` routes; `app/globals.css` styles; `app/layout.tsx` root/mobile viewport handling; `components/` shared UI; `lib/` utilities/analytics/A-B testing; `public/` assets; `tests/` tests; `tests/setup.ts`; `vitest.config.ts`. Use `@/*` imports, appropriate `"use client"`, accessible semantic UI, responsive design and design tokens.

Create `.env.local` from `.env.local.example`: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script

Vitest: jsdom, `tests/` `*.spec.ts?(x)`, excludes Playwright E2E. Playwright validates mobile layout; screenshots in `tests/screenshots/`. CI: Use `pnpm ci:verify` for comprehensive validation before commits. Builds ignore ESLint/TypeScript errors for deployment compatibility.

Husky pre-commit:
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."

Husky pre-push:
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }

**Branch Protection**: Feature branch workflow enforced - all changes to main must go through PRs.
